sources.title: GLM-5: from Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We present GLM-5, a next-generation foundation model designed to transition the paradigm of vibe coding to agentic engineering. Building upon the agentic, reasoning, and coding (ARC) capabilities of its predecessor, GLM-5 adopts DSA to significantly reduce training and inference costs while maintaining long-context fidelity.
